profile.headline: Software Engineer at University of Southern California

positions.title: Development Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
•Develops sophisticated programming and processes for company proprietary system using PICK BASIC and Python.
•Designs programs and processes to meet the needs of end-users. 
•Works closely with workgroups to develop software that increases productivity and efficiency. 
•Provides programming and technical services such as reports and custom features to all workgroups within the company.
•Assists in the managing and solving of incident and change ticket requests.

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description:
•Developed a dynamic webpage using JavaScript, CSS, and HTML to display a live feed of approved vendors from a Google Sheet.
•Inputted Vendor data in the Google Sheets database to ensure the most up-to-date information from the vendors.
•Assisted in the creation of a more efficient and connected database system, to review educational vendors for LAUSD using Google Sheets.
•Generated reports of vendor review results for management using Google Sheets and its formatting tools.
•Troubleshot the Google Sheets system when an unexpected issue would come up, by analyzing the problem and fixing the function that broke.

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer Intern
positions.description:
•Gained experience in technologies like Meteor and MongoDB to develop web, mobile, and desktop applications.
•Collaborated on tasks in a small group of interns using Git and GitHub for version control.
